decision: Chose sqlite_index: app ADR 0008 says report data is never cached only in process memory, so an in-memory LRU would conflict. Mira's 50 MB cache limit is recorded as a new draft ADR in mira-app.

recorded.info: New ADR, status Proposed and awaiting the coordinator's confirmation. It records that the report cache must never grow past 50 MB and that the kiosk has 1 GB of RAM. It also records the choice of a SQLite index over an in-memory LRU, because of ADR 0008.
